_comment: Which fork commit pairs with this repo's state. Same pattern as wowsims.lock.json (plan decision D1). branchedFrom is the upstream commit this fork branch actually sits on -- read it as a fact about the clone, not as a restatement of wowsims.lock.json. As of 2026-09-10 both this file and data/wowsims.lock.json name ec5c5f205e61049d730e460967f8488774a7fe2a on feature/backend-reforge (ADR-0030); ticket 251 is closed with a shape-changed note, since the engine pin moving onto the branch was a fourth option that ticket never contemplated. commit is the fork HEAD this repo's state pairs with, on feat/upgrades-tab at or above the merge commit that brought that upstream commit in, so branchedFrom remains its merge-base with upstream (verified with `git merge-base <commit> <branchedFrom>` in the clone). As of 0b50f402 it is three commits past that merge: a layout-gate fix to test-layout.mjs, which is our own tooling living in the fork tree, not upstream source; a ported-engine edit to upgrades/engine/disclosure.ts with its PROVENANCE sha (ticket 351); and an adapter-only change to upgrades/adapters/sim_database.ts plus its one wiring line in upgrades_tab.tsx, merging the player's item-swap gear into the per-request SimDatabase so a page whose defaults enable item swap no longer panics the sim on an unworn swap item (ticket 362). That last one touches nothing under upgrades/engine, so no PROVENANCE row moved. The clone at clonePath is gitignored (vendor/) and has its own .git pushing to the personal fork. pushed:true records that the branch is on that remote: pushed 2026-09-10 at the owner's explicit ask, a fast-forward d49096e9 -> 0b50f402, verified with `git -C vendor/tbc-new-fork ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/upgrades-tab` returning this file's commit. That closes ticket 355 -- before the push the pin existed on one disk while data/sim-implemented-effects.json embedded it, so those committed artifacts were unre-derivable anywhere else. Flipping this flag stays a deliberate act: a later fork commit moves commit ahead of the remote again, so re-verify with ls-remote rather than trusting the flag. As of 812db29d it is four commits past that merge: ticket 350 adds the ported-engine edit to upgrades/engine/rank.ts with its PROVENANCE sha (candidateSwapWithRepairs clears the worn off hand for a two-handed main-hand candidate, so the composed set is one the game can equip), plus the tab's removed-item disclosure line and one additive i18n key in our own upgrades_tab namespace with its schema property and required entry. Pushed 2026-09-10, a fast-forward 0b50f4026 -> 812db29d3, verified with `git -C vendor/tbc-new-fork ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/upgrades-tab` returning this file's commit. As of f90b12a7b it is five commits past that merge: an import-sort pass over the files we own in the fork (upgrades/, upgrades_tab.tsx), run ahead of the new `pnpm fork-lint:check` gate that lints them -- 23 simple-import-sort warnings cleared by `oxlint --fix` plus one import/no-duplicates merged by hand in upgrades_tab.tsx. Every changed line is an import line; fourteen ported files under upgrades/engine changed bytes, so their PROVENANCE.md rows carry fresh sha256 values, and E-W3 (packages/core/test/wowsims-fork-parity.test.ts) passed both before the hashes moved and after. No upstream wowsims file is touched. Pushed 2026-09-11, a fast-forward 812db29d3 -> f90b12a7b, verified with `git -C vendor/tbc-new-fork ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/upgrades-tab` returning this file's commit. As of 5e9013b78 it is seven commits past that merge, and `pushed` is back to false: bbad1b8a4 reverted the dead iterations parameter on makeRaidSimRequest (it was already in the clone when this branch started, one commit ahead of the f90b12a7b pin -- the condition ticket 372 filed), and 5e9013b78 guards the three non-null assertions in ui/core/components/sim_header.tsx. That file is an upstream wowsims file, not a ported engine file -- `grep -c sim_header vendor/tbc-new-fork/ui/core/components/individual_sim_ui/upgrades/engine/PROVENANCE.md` returns 0 -- so no PROVENANCE row moves and no drift cycle applies. bbad1b8a4 is on the remote -- `git -C vendor/tbc-new-fork ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/upgrades-tab` returns bbad1b8a4325d8168758a909a520cf4dced875f6 -- and 5e9013b78 is not, which is why `pushed` is false: this file's commit is one ahead of the remote tip. Re-verify with that same ls-remote before flipping `pushed` back.
